body:
So I'm loading both the FBX and the DAE with the exact same (ASSIMP) code, and here is what I get for the camera matrices:

```
main.fbx
transform: mat4(
-100.000000, 0.000004, -0.000039, 0.000000, 
0.000004, 100.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 
0.000039, -0.000000, -100.000000, 0.000000, 
1054.672363, 198.692459, 13.696361, 1.000000)

main.dae
transform: mat4(
-0.000000, 1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 
0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000, 0.000000, 
1.000000, 0.000000, -0.000000, 0.000000, 
10.546721, -0.136964, 1.986925, 1.000000)
```

The last line show there is an obvious difference : the FBX matrix translation is 100x the DAE one.
So you'd think the scale of the FBX matrix would be 0.01, but instead it's 100.

That's one of the issues but there are many others of course.

Where could this come from?

Regards,

issue.body:
I have noticed that when it comes to import a camera or a light, its
position and direction are encoded within the transformation matrix, which
is good for child nodes.
So aiLight->mPosition is always (0, 0, 0) and similarly aiLight->mDirection
is (0, 0, -1). I could test only Collada files exported through 3D Studio
Max. Is it true in general, even for other formats or modelling programs?

Check https://sourceforge.net/p/assimp/discussion/817654/thread/79f55300/?limit=25#5471
